landing.tagline: Your career OS, powered by a knowledge base
landing.heroTitle: Reinvent hiring and your career with AI
landing.heroDesc: uCareerOS unifies job sources across China, the US, and Japan. AI matches roles to your profile, flags scams, and generates multi-language resumes — while every insight compounds into a career knowledge base that is truly yours.
landing.feat1.title: Multi-source job radar
landing.feat1.desc: 15+ connectors span 100+ sources across China, the US, and Japan, auto-deduplicating and surfacing the newest postings.
landing.feat2.title: Resume ↔ JD matcher
landing.feat2.desc: Runs entirely in your browser — no upload needed. Highlights matched and missing keywords in real time and shows a graded match score.
landing.feat3.title: Scam & fraud detection
landing.feat3.desc: Paste a job description and AI flags red flags like upfront-fee deposits, training loans, and fake resale gigs, with a risk level.
landing.feat4.title: Company & source leaderboard
landing.feat4.desc: A public ranking by posting volume shows at a glance which companies and channels are actively hiring.
landing.feat5.title: Multi-language resumes
landing.feat5.desc: From one career profile, auto-generate Chinese, English (with visa details), and Japanese (resume + career history) documents.
landing.feat6.title: A career knowledge base that compounds
landing.feat6.desc: Jobs, matches, and feedback accumulate continuously, so it understands you better the more you use it — not just another isolated job-hunt CRM.
landing.regionDesc: China, the US, and Japan have very different resume expectations. uCareerOS manages your career profile once and auto-produces the right version for each target region.
landing.ctaDesc: The free tools work without login; sign up to unlock multi-language resumes and your career knowledge base.
landing.footer: uCareerOS · Data refreshed hourly · Privacy-first; job tools run fully locally

landing.region.cn.p3: Scam flags redefined for local context (upfront deposits / training loans)
